newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Restaurant Brands lists at 9.1 pct premium.
newsitem.headline: Restaurant Brands lists at 9.1 pct premium.

text.p: Shares in Restaurant Brands New Zealand Ltd listed on Wednesday at NZ$2.40 per share, a 20-cent (9.1 percent) premium to its $2.20 issue price.
The stock later hit NZ$2.50 before easing back to $2.46 in heavy volume of over 6 million shares in the first half-hour of trade.
Restaurant Brands was formed to take over the restaurant franchise operations of Pepsico Inc in New Zealand.
The issue price was at the top of the indicative NZ$1.80-$2.20 range and the offer was heavily oversubscribed.
Tim Snedden at brokers ANZ Securities said it was a healthy debut for the stock, particularly given the flat market overall.
"It's indicative of a pretty successful float," he said.
After 30 minutes 6.96 million shares, equivalent to 8.2 percent of the shares on issue, had traded.
"When you get a premium like that there is plenty of stagging (profit-taking) margin in there and it's not surprising to see a few people turn them over," Snedden said.
Restaurant Brands is expected to have about 15,000 shareholders with about 61 percent of its shares held by New Zealand retail and institutional investors.
Analysts had predicted that the isse would be well-supported after promotions in New Zealand and overseas.
